new_jobs.title: Senior Business Operations and Pricing Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Responsibilities** MaxLinear is seeking a Senior Business Operations and Pricing Manager to join our Analog and Mixed\-Signal business team. This role is the key business partner to Product Line Management, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Manufacturing Operations to drive data\-based business decisions, demand planning, pricing execution, revenue growth, and operational excellence. In this role, you will focus on the following: * Lead the business unit’s quarterly demand forecasting process, including consolidation of regional inputs, opportunity assumptions, inventory position, and product line priorities * Provide raw material and product demand forecasts in coordination with Marketing, Product Management, Manufacturing Operations, and Supply Planning teams * Support Product Line Managers and Marketing Managers with business analysis, pricing models, opportunity tracking, revenue forecasts, and management reporting * Manage sample request reviews, special pricing requests, and price quote escalations to support customer engagements while maintaining business discipline * Partner with regional sales teams to identify new revenue opportunities, channel programs, and customer growth initiatives * Apply strong knowledge of semiconductor sales and distribution models, including MPP, POP, POSC, forecast consumption, channel inventory, and point\-of\-sale trends * Evaluate channel inventory, internal available\-to\-ship supply, and customer demand signals to recommend actions that accelerate regional revenue growth * Develop and recommend product pricing actions to regional sales teams to support quarterly revenue targets, gross margin objectives, and competitive positioning * Align with Sales Operations on ship schedules, backlog coverage, revenue pacing, allocation priorities, and gross margin impact * Prepare weekly business performance reports covering bookings, billings, backlog, revenue outlook, quote activity, opportunity funnel, channel inventory, and key customer actions * Conduct quarterly business reviews and trend analysis to identify risks, opportunities, pricing actions, and operational improvements * Maintain routine tracking of top customer opportunities in partnership with the sales organization, including next steps, owners, timing, and revenue impact * Coordinate quarterly opportunity funnel reviews with regional sales teams and provide actionable insights to business unit leadership * Support creation, maintenance, and governance of product column pricing; conduct competitive pricing analysis and recommend adjustments as needed * Build scalable dashboards, operating rhythms, and decision frameworks that improve forecast accuracy, pricing responsiveness, and cross\-functional execution **Qualifications** * Bachelors in Business, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, Operations, or related \+ 10 years of experience, or Master’s \+ 8 years of experience * Semiconductor industry experience required * Demonstrated experience in business operations, sales operations, pricing, demand planning, product marketing, or related roles within the semiconductor industry * Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate bookings, billings, backlog, inventory, pricing, and opportunity data into clear business insights and recommendations * Experience developing demand assessments, revenue outlooks, pricing quotations, and gross margin analysis * Proven ability to create effective executive\-level presentations and communicate complex business issues clearly to management * Track record of success in fast\-paced, results\-driven business operations, tactical marketing, demand planning, or revenue execution environments * Ability to prioritize competing business needs, manage multiple workstreams, and collaborate effectively across Product Management, Sales, Finance, Operations, and Marketing * Prior experience in sales, sales operations, or distribution/channel management is strongly preferred * High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with business intelligence tools, CRM systems, ERP systems, or pricing tools is a plus * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong follow\-through, ownership, and attention to detail * Comfortable operating independently, driving cross\-functional alignment, and escalating issues with fact\-based recommendations **Company Overview** MaxLinear is a global, NASDAQ\-traded company (MXL) where the entrepreneurial spirit is alive and well. We are a fabless system\-on\-chip product company, striving to improve the world’s communication networks for everyone through our highly integrated radio\-frequency (RF), analog, digital, and mixed\-signal semiconductor solutions for access and connectivity, wired and wireless infrastructure, and industrial and multi\-market applications. We hire the best people in the industry and engage them in some of the most exciting opportunities that connect the world we live in today. Our growth has come from innovative, bold approaches to solving some of the world’s most challenging communication technology problems in the most efficient and effective manner. MaxLinear began by developing the world’s first high\-performance TV tuner chip using standard CMOS process technology. Others said we couldn’t achieve the extremely high\-performance requirements using CMOS, but we proved them wrong and achieved enduring global market leadership with our designs. Since then, we’ve developed a full line of products that drive 4G and 5G infrastructure; enable data center, metro and long\-haul optical interconnects; bring 10Gbit to the home; power the IoT revolution; and enable robust and reliable communication in harsh industrial environments. Over the years, we’ve expanded through organic growth and through several acquisitions that have perfectly complemented our existing portfolio and enabled us to deliver complete end\-to\-end solutions in our target markets. One such example was the acquisition of Intel’s Home Gateway Platform Division that added Wi\-Fi, Ethernet, and Broadband Gateway Processor SoC technology to our connected home portfolio creating a complete and scalable platform of connectivity and access solutions to fully address our customers’ needs. Our headquarters are in Carlsbad, near San Diego, California. We also have major design centers in Irvine and San Jose, California; Valencia, Spain; Bangalore, India; Munich, Germany; Israel; and Singapore. We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. Our employees thrive on innovation, outstanding execution, outside\-the\-box thinking, nimbleness, and collaboration. Together, we form a high\-energy business team that is focused on building the best and most innovative products on the market.

This group works to deliver optimized AI solutions by partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders. The team's mission is to enable impactful AI applications, advance technical innovation, and support Intel's broader goals in high\-performance computing and artificial intelligence domains. Join a collaborative environment where your contributions will help shape the future of AI\-powered solutions. Key Responsibilities \- Research and prototype AI solutions, leveraging Intel products to optimize performance and drive customer adoption. \- Develop AI software, including open\-source libraries, models, and tools, tailored to diverse applications. \- Optimize AI model performance using deep expertise in frameworks, algorithms, and hardware. \- Implement adjustments to AI models, parameters, code, and quantization to enhance functionality and performance. \- Collaborate with AI algorithm and framework engineers to optimize end\-to\-end AI solutions for Intel hardware. \- Serve as a trusted technical advisor, enabling customers and partners to maximize the value of Intel AI products. \- Partner with product development teams to accelerate application pre\-enablement and optimize future Intel hardware and software products. \- Deliver differentiated benchmark collateral and identify key workloads to inform product requirements and drive innovation **Qualifications** Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, demonstrated through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands\-on training; OR a Master's degree in a relevant field. \- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, or similar languages. \- Familiarity with AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and their optimization techniques. \- Solid practical experience with PyTorch and/or ONNX (implementing custom modules, forward passes, or inference pipelines). \- In\-depth understanding of modern neural network architectures (Transformers, Attention mechanisms, CNNs, Diffusion models, MoE). new_jobs.jd: 🌟Reports to Portfolio Manager🌟This is a newly created role🌟 **PURPOSE OF JOB:** * The Brand Manager – Multi\-Brands is responsible for driving brand growth and marketing execution for assigned brands within the portfolio. Reporting to the Portfolio Manager, this role translates the overall portfolio strategy into clear brand plans, campaigns, innovations, and consumer initiatives that strengthen brand power, penetration, market share, and value share. * As the brand owner for assigned brands, the Brand Manager leads end\-to\-end brand planning and execution, including campaign development, media planning, creative adaptation, consumer activation, innovation support, and performance tracking. The role works closely with cross\-functional teams, regional/global stakeholders, and agency partners to deliver locally relevant plans with strong commercial impact. **MAJOR ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Brand Strategy \& Growth** * Translate portfolio direction into clear brand plans for assigned brands, with defined objectives, target consumers, occasions, growth priorities, and KPIs. * Support the Portfolio Manager in identifying growth opportunities across mainstream, premium, trading brands, and/or Beyond Beer segments. * Drive initiatives that strengthen brand power, recruit new users, and improve penetration, market share, and value share. * Use consumer, category, competitor, and channel insights to shape brand plans and identify business opportunities. * Ensure assigned brands contribute to the wider portfolio growth agenda and help build additional growth engines for the OpCo. **Marketing Campaign Development \& Execution** * Lead the development and execution of through\-the\-line marketing campaigns, including communication plans, media strategy, creative assets, digital/social activation, events, and consumer engagement. * Adapt global and regional brand concepts into locally relevant campaigns with clear consumer insight and strong creative ideas. * Manage external agency partners to deliver quality output, on\-time execution, and performance against KPIs. * Work closely with Trade Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure strong commercial relevance and flawless execution. * Ensure consistent brand messaging and high\-quality execution across all consumer and trade touchpoints. **Performance, Budget \& Learning** * Set and track brand and campaign KPIs, including brand power, penetration, trial, conversion, market share, volume, and investment effectiveness where applicable. * Monitor performance regularly, identify risks or bottlenecks, and recommend action plans within budget, timeline, and resource constraints. * Manage assigned A\&P budgets, expenses, invoices, and budget tracking accurately. * Conduct post\-campaign evaluations and share clear learnings and recommendations to support a learn/share/reapply culture. **Innovation \& Portfolio Support** * Support innovation, seasonal launches, and portfolio extension opportunities for assigned brands. * Source and assess relevant product opportunities from the broader HEINEKEN portfolio for local test\-and\-learn where applicable. * Oversee product\-related development, packaging, and design adaptation in partnership with internal teams and regional/global stakeholders. **Stakeholder Management** * Work closely with the Portfolio Manager to ensure brand plans are aligned with portfolio priorities and business objectives. * Collaborate with global and regional teams on brand direction, campaign planning, innovation, and business updates. * Lead cross\-functional project teams to deliver brand initiatives with quality and speed. * Provide regular updates on brand performance, campaign progress, risks, and recommended actions. * Support broader Marketing and portfolio\-related projects when required. **EXPERIENCE:** * 5\+ years of marketing experience, preferably in FMCG, consumer goods, alcoholic beverages, lifestyle, or other fast\-moving consumer categories. * Experience in brand management, campaign development, and through\-the\-line marketing execution. * Experience managing multiple brands, product lines, or consumer segments is preferred. * Experience working with global or regional teams is preferred. * Experience in innovation, new product development, or portfolio extension is a plus. * Experience working with Sales, Trade Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and external agency partners. * Good command of written and verbal English communication. **EDUCATION / QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree required. * Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field is preferred. **JOB\-RELATED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS** * Strong brand ownership mindset, with the ability to manage assigned brands from planning to execution. * Strong business acumen and ability to connect brand plans with commercial outcomes. * Good understanding of consumer insights, category dynamics, competitors, and channel realities. * Strong creative judgment and ability to deliver distinctive, locally relevant campaigns. * Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple brands, timelines, and stakeholders. * Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills. * Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret market data and campaign performance. * Experience with Nielsen retail data or similar market data tools is preferred. * Strong ownership, resilience, and focus on results.

new_jobs.title: Staff Product Manager– Consumer Electronics & IoT Connectivity
new_jobs.jd: ****Company:**** Qualcomm Communication Technologies Ltd. ****Job Area:**** Operations Group, Operations Group \> Product Management ****General Summary:**** Qualcomm is a leading provider of wireless connectivity solutions for IoT applications, offering a broad portfolio of wireless SoCs spanning Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, 802\.15\.4 (Thread/Zigbee), 4G/LTE cellular, 5G, GNSS, and more. In this role, you will lead Global Product Management and marketing efforts for the Consumer Electronics \& IOT Connectivity Product Lines in order to drive market expansion for Qualcomm’s short\-range wireless MCU SoC portfolio, including Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, Bluetooth Low Energy, and 802\.15\.4 (Thread/Zigbee). You will play a key role in accelerating global customer adoption and expanding market presence for Qualcomm’s wireless SoC solutions across various market segments in the Consumer Electronics and IoT Connectivity space. ****Responsibilities:**** * Lead the global growth and strategic management of Qualcomm’s short\-range wireless SoC portfolio, including Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and 802\.15\.4 solutions, ensuring global alignment and across multiple market segments * Identify and synthesize global market requirements and trends across geographies, translating insights into new feature definitions and influencing the long\-term Wireless MCU SoC roadmap * Drive worldwide design wins and deepen engagement with key global customers and ecosystem partners, building a scalable and diversified revenue pipeline * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Business Unit Product Management and global Engineering teams to align on priorities, ensure execution consistency, and deliver impactful business and product outcomes at scale * Lead global Product Marketing initiatives in partnership with all regional (US, EU, LatAm, APAC) teams and channel partners to expand Qualcomm’s reach, ensure consistent messaging, and accelerate adoption in both mature and emerging markets * Develop and execute a globally scalable business model for Wi\-Fi module offerings, working closely with international module partners to enable competitive pricing, regional adaptability, and differentiated value\-added solutions * Represent Qualcomm globally at industry forums, trade shows, and standards bodies, reinforcing the company’s leadership and influence in wireless connectivity technologies * Partner closely with regional sales and business development teams worldwide to scale opportunities, strengthen strategic customer relationships, and drive coordinated market expansion efforts * Own CBN/CE\-IOT Connectivity Business Product Lines global revenue growth objectives and long\-term business strategy, ensuring all regional alignment with overarching corporate priorities and driving sustainable growth across all geographies * Drive global CBN/CE‑IoT connectivity revenue and margin accountability, ensuring a balanced and diversified geographic performance by strategically allocating focus and limiting over\-dependence on any single region (with no more than 1/3 engagement and 20–30% revenue contribution, to deliver consistent quarterly and annual results against global business objectives ****Minimum Qualifications:**** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline * 10\+ years of experience in wireless MCU technologies, with deep expertise in Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, and 802\.15\.4 solutions * 5\+ years of experience in product management, business development, or technical marketing within the semiconductor or wireless connectivity industry * Strong understanding of Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, and 802\.15\.4 technologies, including associated chipsets, software stacks, embedded operating systems (RTOS/Linux/Android) and market ecosystems * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to internal and external stakeholders * Demonstrated problem\-solving capabilities, with a proactive and resourceful approach to addressing technical and business challenges * Ability to travel globally to support business and customer engagement needs ****Preferred Qualifications:**** * Demonstrated experience in Product Marketing/Management and Business Development for Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, and 802\.15\.4 wireless MCU solutions * Proven track record in product management or business development roles at leading suppliers in the Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, and 802\.15\.4 wireless MCU industry * Experience with wireless connectivity modules, including module RBOMs, cost structures, manufacturing considerations, regulatory requirements, and the ecosystem of available module partners/manufacturers * Ability to operate effectively within a matrixed organization, building alignment and driving execution across cross\-functional teams * Entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, navigate ambiguity, and drive business growth * Self\-motivated and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision * Passion for wireless connectivity technologies and for enabling customer success in dynamic market environments ****Minimum Qualifications:**** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related technical field. * 5\+ years of Product Management or related work experience. * Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s \= one year, Doctorate \= two years) of work experience. **Applicants** : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer.
